title: Regulatory Submission Authoring contract v1
description: Chains source-ingest -> section-plan -> section-draft -> consistency-check -> submission-assemble. Data + confidence + provenance + citations on every hop; citations are required, not optional, so grounding survives every hand-off.

standards_alignment.note: Named per Industry Templates standard section 6 - only genuine correspondences are mapped.

primary.standard: ICH E3 (Structure and Content of Clinical Study Reports)
primary.maps: submission.target_doc and config/submission-templates.json csr.required_sections (Synopsis, Efficacy Evaluation, Safety Evaluation, Discussion and Overall Conclusions) follow the ICH E3 CSR section order; draft_sections[].section names are ICH E3 section titles.
submission.submission_type selects the target module structure; assembly_status is deliberately constrained to draft states so no eCTD lifecycle/sequence state (submitted, filed) is representable.

source_facts keys are the analysis-level counts and dates produced by ADaM-derived TLFs (ADSL disposition counts: enrolled/randomized/completed/safety population; ADaM efficacy results); source_facts[].citation names the TLF table or SAP section carrying the value, which is the SDTM/ADaM traceability anchor.

not_mapped: HL7 FHIR / C-CDA - no clinical exchange payload is produced by this plugin.
eSTAR 510(k) is a template structure only (config/submission-templates.json), not a data-standard mapping.

action_level.description: Staged autonomy. L0 = read/analyse, L1 = draft for human approval. This plugin never exceeds L1: nothing is filed, sent or submitted.

source_facts.description: Authoritative fact map from source-ingest. Every fact cites its grounding (submission-rules.md #5).

asserted.description: Structured facts asserted by the drafted prose. Each carries the citation it was drafted from; it must match the source fact's citation.

assembly_status.description: submission-rules.md #3 - draft states only. 'submitted'/'filed' is unrepresentable by schema, not merely by convention.

value.description: The verbatim source value - number, date or population definition. Never re-derived.

citation.description: Source document plus table/section reference, e.g. 'TLF Table 14.1.1 - Subject disposition' or 'SAP v2.0 s4.2'.
